$comment: Generated from src/questions.ts. Do not edit by hand; run `bun run emit`.

scoring.gapOrder: descending by points recoverable, ties broken by ascending costRank
scoring.weighting: equal across questions; a stated version-1 limitation, not a finding

questions.label: Vendor replaceability
questions.question: Can the primary vendor be replaced without rebuilding the institution?
questions.sharpener: Not “is there an alternative.” Could you actually do it this quarter.
questions.remediation: Rehearse the migration once, in staging. A plan nobody has attempted is not a capability.

questions.label: Runtime portability
questions.question: Can the runtime move to another environment?
questions.sharpener: Counts only if someone has done it, in staging at minimum.
questions.remediation: Run it somewhere else once, even in staging, and write down what broke.

questions.label: Data recovery
questions.question: Can the organization retain and reconstruct its data and knowledge?
questions.sharpener: Including embeddings, prompts, and eval sets, not just the database.
questions.remediation: Export embeddings, prompts and eval sets, not just the database. Check you can reload them.

questions.label: Agent auditability
questions.question: Can agent permissions and actions be inspected?
questions.sharpener: A log of prompts is not a log of permissions.
questions.remediation: Log the permission, not the prompt.

questions.label: Model swappability
questions.question: Can models be swapped without rewriting business logic?
questions.sharpener: If a model name appears in application code, the answer is no.
questions.remediation: Route through a capability declaration so no model name appears in application code.

questions.label: Network isolation
questions.question: Can critical functions operate privately or in restricted networks where required?
questions.sharpener: Relevant only if a regulator, contract, or jurisdiction requires it.
questions.remediation: Identify which functions actually carry the obligation, then test one in a restricted network.

questions.label: Key custody
questions.question: Does the organization retain identity, keys, policy, authorization, provenance, and audit?
questions.sharpener: All six. Losing any one of them loses the set.
questions.remediation: List where each of the six lives today. Any held only by a vendor is the one to move first.
